We have two teams dropping out: Someone’s Team and Coates and Hoes (Someone). Also, Someone will be sitting this year out, so I’d like to welcome Owner 0002, who will be taking over his team.

I propose the following:
- the players from Someone and Someone’s teams become UFAs
- we increase the cap from 250 to 300
- we add five roster spots to every team
- we add two starters
- we update formations to the following:
1-2 QB (currently 1)
1-3 RB (currently 1-2)
2-5 WR (currently 2-4)
1-3 TE (currently 1-2)
- we update QB scoring to 4pts per passing TD and 1 pt per 30 passing
- All draft picks currently owned by Someone and Someone go away. Any that they had traded would remain intact
- Add one extra round to the rookie draft

This is just to get the ball rolling. If there are alternate suggestions, feel free to post them.

All of this looks good to me.
However, if we drop PTDs to 4pts from 6pts I think we should change INTs to -1pt rather than -2pts.

Also, should we take this opportunity to consider removing kickers from our starting rosters? We could still stick with the 30 man roster, but just lose that starting spot.
I’m fine either way, but I remember it coming up for a vote in the past so I thought I’d put it out there.

After reviewing historical QB scoring a little more, I'd like to change the proposal to the following

1 pt for 40 passing
3 pt for passing TD
-1 for INT

The reason for this is I'd prefer the QB flex spot not be an auto-QB, which will inflate QB values significantly. Under this scoring system, the 16th QB last year would have had similar overall points to the 56th flex spot, which at least makes it possible that you'd consider not starting 2 QB if you had good depth elsewhere.

As far as removing kickers, it has always been controversial, but we can certainly vote on it.
We also have to pick a schedule. I assume we'd do 14 week regular season, 4 teams make the playoffs?

Change all-play to $0.75, weekly winner to $15

Week 12 trade deadline.

Blind bid waivers will process tonight at 11pm (this will happen every Wed. night during the season). After waivers process you can sign any free agents for $1 until noon Sunday (assuming they haven't had their game yet).

NOTE: The blind bidding uses a conditional bidding system. I can't go back and change bids if you make a mistake, so if you're not sure about how it works post the question here ahead of time and we'll try to clarify.

Dates and times are on the league calendar as well: https://www53.myfantasyleague.com/2021/home/48571#4

Hi everyone. You may have noticed that the web site scheduled some double headers this week. To be honest, I have no idea how this happened. I'm certain I checked that the schedules looked good before the season started, but obviously I missed something, and nobody else caught it either. So now we have a bit of a conundrum.

I think we have a couple of options.

1) We can roll with the double headers (there are several more scheduled).
2) I can randomly regenerate a new schedule. That means the opponent you have this week (and subsequent weeks) may change. The weeks already played would remain.

To me, #2 seems the most fair. Double headers was not something we agreed on before the season. And putting this to a vote invites impartiality, because some may have done well this week, and would like to keep their two wins. So I plan on doing that, but I'd like to give the rest of the league a chance to dissent before making a decision. If you have an opinion, post it in here.

Sorry for the screwup!

Commish
I am fine with a random rescheduling
I actually have a triple header this week. Let's randomly reschedule. It's the most fair solution.
It would really suck to win both games of a double header only to be randomized into a loss, but if that’s what we think has to happen then I guess there’s really no other option.

Ok, I'm going to go with rescheduling. Everyone that has chimed in agreed that is the most fair. Even Someone, who would have won his triple header, so if anyone has a right to complain it's him :)

I'll try to get it generated and in place tonight if the web site cooperates with me.

One thing I would suggest is that complete randomization doesn’t make sense.  That is, we’ve already played 3 teams this season, so it wouldn’t make sense to have any of those rematches in week 4. It should be randomized with the 4 teams we haven’t matched up against so far.
I’ll do my best. It turns out generating a schedule with 3 weeks locked in isn’t as straightforward as one might think. I’ll share the methodology I’ll be using before generating it.

Ok I have something that works. I was unable to find a schedule generator that would do this for us, so I wrote a short program. Here's how it works:

1) generate a schedule with random opponents for weeks 4-7 to ensure that each team plays each other team once in weeks 1-7
2) generate a schedule with random opponents for weeks 8-14 to ensure that each team plays each other team once in weeks 8-14
